main.description: A patron's signed proof that a quest was delivered and PAID PEER-TO-PEER — the objective delivery anchor + eligibility context for delivery/split attestations. The platform never custodies funds; parties pay each other directly via any rail and this record attests the OUTCOME only (no card data / PII). Payments may be PROGRESSIVE: each settlement records a slice (`amount`) of the agreed total (`of`), and a client sums settlements against the agreement to reach 'fully paid'; `for` ties a slice to the delivery it settles. The payee co-signs by confirming receipt (a pays.promptly attestation). Carry `evidence` (e.g. a crypto txid) so independent auditors can check it; un-evidenced payments are flagged. Written to the patron's repo.

agreement.description: Optional strongRef to the org.buildguild.acceptance, so payment is judged against what was AGREED.

for.description: Optional strongRef to the org.buildguild.delivery this slice pays for (closes the deliver-pay loop).

payee.description: The guild (AT-URI / id) or builder DID that was paid.

party.description: Builder DIDs on the delivering party (grants splits.fair eligibility).

amount.description: This payment's slice in minor units (e.g. cents) — integer, never a float. For a single full payment, the whole reward; for progressive payment, one installment.

of.description: Optional agreed reward TOTAL in minor units, for summing progressive slices toward 'fully paid'. Omit to inherit the agreement's amount.

paymentRef.description: Opaque off-protocol payment reference (e.g. a Venmo note or bank memo). NEVER card numbers or PII.

evidence.description: Independently-checkable proof of payment — ideally a crypto txid (verifiable on-chain by anyone). Settlements with no evidence are flagged by the auditor.
